content_sections.heading: About Utkal University Research Assistant
content_sections.text: The Centre of Excellence in Integrated Omics and Computational Biology (CoE-IOCB) is a centre of Utkal University, located in the CIF Building on the Vani Vihar campus in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The two Research Assistant posts are project-mode engagements at this centre, supported under a sustainable grant of OSHEC-Govt. of Odisha. The notice is issued by the Coordinator, CoE-IOCB.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: M.Sc. in Biotechnology/Botany/Zoology/Allied subjects of Life Sciences with a minimum 55% marks. Preference: Candidates with research experience in the related area may be given preference. The notice does not mention an age limit. For the full wording of the eligibility conditions, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration of a Research Assistant is Rs. 20,000.00 (Rupees twenty thousand) only per month. The engagement is on a purely temporary basis under project mode, and the tenure of engagement will be up to 31.03.2027 or, as decided by the funding agency. The notice does not mention any allowance in addition to this remuneration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Utkal University Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and supportive documents (certificates and marksheets). Send them by e-mail to the Coordinator, CoE-IOCB, at [email protected] latest by 06.12.2026 up to 5.00 p.m. Attend the walk-in interview on 08.12.2026 at the Centre of Excellence in Integrated Omics and Computational Biology (CoE-IOCB), CIF Building, Utkal University, Bhubaneswar. Report at least one hour before the interview with your bio-data, original certificates and a set of xerox copies of all marksheets and certificates for verification. CV (to be e-mailed) Certificates and marksheets (to be e-mailed) Bio-data (to bring to the interview) Original certificates (to bring to the interview) A set of all marksheets and certificates as xerox copies, in support of educational qualifications, experience and credibility (to bring to the interview)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview on 08.12.2026 (Tuesday) between 10.30 A.M. and 02.30 P.M. at the Centre of Excellence in Integrated Omics and Computational Biology (CoE-IOCB), CIF Building, Utkal University, Bhubaneswar. Before the interview, candidates' educational qualifications, experience and credibility are verified from their documents, for which candidates must be present at least one hour before the interview. Candidates with research experience in the related area may be given preference.

content_sections.text: The authority reserves the right for selection or rejection of any candidate. The authority reserves the right to cancel the notification without assigning any reason. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Assistant vacancies are there at Utkal University?
faq.answer: There are 02 Research Assistant posts at the Centre of Excellence in Integrated Omics and Computational Biology (CoE-IOCB), Utkal University.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to send the CV?
faq.answer: The CV and supportive documents must be e-mailed to [email protected] latest by 6 December 2026, up to 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 8 December 2026 (Tuesday) between 10.30 A.M. and 02.30 P.M. at CoE-IOCB, CIF Building, Utkal University, Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed M.Sc. in Biotechnology/Botany/Zoology/Allied subjects of Life Sciences with a minimum 55% marks; research experience in the related area may be given preference.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 20,000.00 (Rupees twenty thousand) only per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send your CV and supportive documents (certificates and marksheets) by e-mail to [email protected] by 6 December 2026, up to 5.00 p.m., and then attend the walk-in interview on 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on a purely temporary basis under project mode, with a tenure up to 31 March 2027 or as decided by the funding agency.

faq.question: Q8. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring your bio-data, original certificates and a set of xerox copies of all marksheets and certificates, and report at least one hour before the interview for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
